$comment: HZ-128: the contract for domain/steps.json. Validated by domain/validate.mjs — a dependency-free subset validator (no ajv; guardrail 3 forbids a new dependency), so only these keywords are honoured: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, enum, minimum, maximum, minLength, minItems, uniqueItems, allOf, if/then. Cross-field rules a Draft-07 subset cannot express (phase < phases.length, unique labels) are asserted at LOAD time by the bindings themselves instead — see assertLifecycleShape() in domain/js/lifecycle.js and _validate_source() in domain/py/steps.py, which domain/fixtures/lifecycle-cases.json drives from both sides so the two cannot drift.
title: Horizon lifecycle step table

allOf.$comment: An agent-kind step always names its agent and its lane; it never carries a gate.
A gate is human-only: no agent, no lane, no farm budget.

Farm-lane steps carry the full budget/provider contract step_agent.py reads; the PM lane uses farm/pm_steps.py's own budget mechanism and must not declare these, except providerOverrideEligible (HZ-370: a PM step may take the owner's provider choice).
